images.cameraAngle: Front three-quarter; nose screen-left
images.title: First impressions
images.description: A front three-quarter view reveals the sculpted bodywork under the red glow of the studio.
images.similarityNote: Opening view, followed by the direct front. Similar composition to finale, with a different angle and lighting.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. Similar to finale, intentionally retained as an opening and closing pair.
images.reviewNote: Visible content reviewed; real-world vehicle configuration has not been authenticated.

images.cameraAngle: Direct front
images.title: Face to face
images.description: A direct front view brings the low nose and twin headlight clusters into focus.
images.similarityNote: A symmetrical bridge between the two front three-quarter views.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Headlight details differ from the headlight close-up.

images.cameraAngle: Opposite front three-quarter; nose screen-right
images.title: Another perspective
images.description: With the nose pointing to the right of the frame, this view connects the front fascia to the side profile.
images.similarityNote: The nose points in the same direction as the following side-right image.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. Similar orientation to doors-raised, but with closed doors and a lower camera angle.
images.reviewNote: Left and right refer to screen direction, not an assumed driver side.

images.cameraAngle: Side profile; nose screen-right
images.title: An unbroken line
images.description: The full side profile, facing right, contrasts a black roof with the red bodywork.
images.similarityNote: Progresses from front to side to rear on the same side of the car.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. Side-left shows the opposite view; no mirrored image was created.
images.reviewNote: Only the supplied original is used; no reflected view has been generated.

images.cameraAngle: Rear three-quarter; nose screen-right
images.title: A lasting signature
images.description: A rear three-quarter perspective brings the taillights and diffuser into the spotlight.
images.similarityNote: Retains the side seen in the previous image and moves toward the direct rear view.
images.duplicateNote: Similar angle to rear-finale, with different framing and details; deliberately separated in the sequence.
images.reviewNote: Plate lettering and rear-body details are not fully consistent across the supplied images.

images.cameraAngle: Direct rear / 180-degree viewpoint, not a rotation frame
images.title: Rear symmetry
images.description: A straight-on rear view reveals the taillight arrangement and aerodynamic surfaces below.
images.similarityNote: Bridges the two rear three-quarter views.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Exhaust placement differs from some three-quarter views; these are not consistent rotation frames.

images.cameraAngle: Opposite rear three-quarter; nose screen-left
images.title: Around the other side
images.description: From the rear, the camera opens onto the opposite flank and the black roof.
images.similarityNote: Follows the direct rear and shares the direction of the next side-left view.
images.duplicateNote: Similar to door-open, but with a closed door and different framing.
images.reviewNote: The supplied images show differences in rear-body geometry.

images.cameraAngle: Wide side profile; nose screen-left
images.title: The proportions of speed
images.description: A wide side profile keeps the entire car in view. The original aspect ratio is preserved without cropping the nose or tail.
images.similarityNote: Completes the side-profile walkaround before the elevated overview.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. This image has a distinct 1881 x 836 aspect ratio.
images.reviewNote: Letterboxing within the 3:2 stage is intentional to avoid cropping the car.

images.cameraAngle: Elevated diagonal / roof and body overview
images.title: Lines from above
images.description: An elevated diagonal view traces the roof, glazing and transitions between body surfaces.
images.similarityNote: Moves from the side profile to an elevated overview while keeping the entire car in frame.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: An elevated diagonal view, not a perpendicular top-down photograph.

images.cameraAngle: Front three-quarter with two raised doors
images.title: Open doors — an image variation
images.description: This supplied image shows both doors raised. The door configuration differs from other views and does not verify the real vehicle specification.
images.similarityNote: Keeps a wide front view before moving to the rear view with one open door.
images.duplicateNote: Similar orientation to front-opposite, with a different door position.
images.reviewNote: The door mechanism visibly differs from door-open. The source is preserved and the discrepancy is disclosed.

images.cameraAngle: Rear three-quarter; one conventional door open
images.title: A glimpse inside
images.description: A door opens outward in this rear three-quarter view, offering a glimpse of the cockpit before the detail sequence.
images.similarityNote: Shares the rear-facing orientation and open-compartment theme of the next engine-open view.
images.duplicateNote: Similar to rear-quarter-left, but with an open door and different crop; not a copy.
images.reviewNote: The door mechanism differs from doors-raised. No interpolation is performed between these states.

images.cameraAngle: Rear elevated three-quarter, engine cover raised
images.title: Beneath the engine cover
images.description: The raised engine cover draws the eye from the bodywork into the components beneath.
images.similarityNote: Connects the rear angle of door-open to the closer engine-detail view.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate; engine-detail is a separate close-up.
images.reviewNote: Mechanical accuracy cannot be confirmed from this illustration.

images.cameraAngle: Close elevated engine bay
images.title: Inside the engine bay
images.description: A closer look at dark surfaces, pipework and Ferrari lettering within the engine bay.
images.similarityNote: Continues the engine-bay subject before returning to the rear details.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Technical details in the image have not been verified against a real vehicle.

images.cameraAngle: Close low rear, lights / exhaust / diffuser
images.title: Light and aerodynamics
images.description: A close rear view highlights the red taillights, twin exhaust outlets and diffuser surfaces.
images.similarityNote: Stays at the rear before moving closer to the Ferrari emblem.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. Similar area to engine-open, but with a closed cover and lower viewpoint.
images.reviewNote: This image combines rear lighting and aerodynamic details; there is no separate taillight-only source image.

images.cameraAngle: Exterior Ferrari script and prancing horse close-up
images.title: An unmistakable signature
images.description: Ferrari lettering and the prancing horse stand out against the red bodywork.
images.similarityNote: Follows the rear details with a badge close-up, then moves along the flank toward the front wheel.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Describes only the emblems visible in the supplied image.

images.cameraAngle: Front wheel, brake and side sill close-up
images.title: Where power meets the road
images.description: A dark wheel, brake disc and yellow caliper provide a striking contrast against the sculpted flank.
images.similarityNote: Moves along the flank to the front wheel, then continues toward the headlight.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Wheel dimensions and brake materials are not inferred from the image.

images.cameraAngle: Front headlight and fender close-up
images.title: A line of light
images.description: A close-up of the headlight and front fender brings the exterior detail sequence to a close.
images.similarityNote: Shares the front wheel and fender area of wheel, then fades into the cockpit.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: The headlight shape differs from full-car views and does not authenticate an official SF90 configuration.

images.cameraAngle: Wide cabin from passenger doorway
images.title: Step inside
images.description: A wide view through the doorway reveals both seats, the dashboard and the center tunnel.
images.similarityNote: Changes subject with a restrained fade, establishing the cabin before moving toward the dashboard.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: The predominantly red seats differ from the black seats in seats; cabin colors and configurations are not consistent.

images.cameraAngle: Wide centered dashboard and cockpit
images.title: Built around the driver
images.description: The dashboard spans the frame, with the steering wheel on the left and the controls at the center.
images.similarityNote: Moves from the wider cabin to the dashboard and then closer to the steering wheel.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. Shares the cockpit subject but uses a different viewpoint and framing.
images.reviewNote: The control layout has not been authenticated as a factory-production specification.

images.cameraAngle: Steering wheel and instrument cluster close-up
images.title: The center of control
images.description: The steering wheel and instrument display take center stage in this close-up.
images.similarityNote: Narrows the dashboard view before moving to the seats to complete the driver-focused sequence.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate.
images.reviewNote: Small symbols in the image are not treated as functional specifications.

images.cameraAngle: Two sport seats viewed through doorway
images.title: Shaped around you
images.description: Two dark sports seats with red accents, viewed through the doorway.
images.similarityNote: Moves from the steering position to the seating and then to the controls between the seats.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate and not a crop of cockpit.
images.reviewNote: Seat colors and shapes differ from cockpit. The source is preserved and the variation is documented.

images.cameraAngle: Center console / gear selector close-up
images.title: Details within reach
images.description: A close-up of the gear selector and the surfaces surrounding the center console.
images.similarityNote: Ends the cabin sequence on a small detail before returning to a wide exterior view.
images.duplicateNote: Not a duplicate. The console and gear selector share one image; no artificial second image is created.
images.reviewNote: There is no separate interior-material close-up in the source set, and none is generated.

images.cameraAngle: Low rear three-quarter; cinematic closing view
images.title: An echo of red
images.description: Return to a low rear perspective, where studio light sweeps across the bodywork.
images.similarityNote: Opens out from the interior details into the final pair of full-car views.
images.duplicateNote: Similar to rear-quarter-right, but with different rear details, lighting and framing; retained as a closing shot.
images.reviewNote: The diffuser and exhaust placement differ from some other supplied images.

images.cameraAngle: Low dramatic front three-quarter; nose screen-left
images.title: The impression remains
images.description: A low front three-quarter perspective closes the journey, echoing the opening image.
images.similarityNote: A full-car closing view intentionally returns to the first-impression theme; it does not simulate continuous rotation.
images.duplicateNote: Similar to first-impression, but with a different camera angle, flank coverage and lighting; not a copy.
images.reviewNote: The two closing views form an editorial montage, not adjacent physical rotation frames.
